skill.name: php-best-practices
skill.description: PHP 8.x strict typing, modern language features, explicit error handling, security, performance, architecture, PSR standards, and PHPStan/static-analysis guidance.
skill.author: php-community

abstract: PHP 8.x best-practices guidance for AI coding agents covering types, modern PHP, error handling, security, performance, architecture/design, PSR standards, and quality tooling/static analysis. Detect the project's PHP version before suggesting features, prefer explicit analyzable contracts, and validate with the repository's configured toolchain.

categories.name: Types
categories.description: Strict declarations, explicit native types, composition types, never/void, and explicit nullability

categories.name: Modern PHP
categories.description: Enums, readonly, property hooks, constructor arguments, modern expressions, and attributes with version-aware use

categories.name: Error Handling
categories.description: Typed/contextual exceptions, narrow catches, cleanup, and no diagnostic suppression

categories.name: Security
categories.description: Parameterized SQL, context-aware escaping, password hashing, and safe upload boundaries

categories.name: Performance
categories.description: Generators/streaming, native operations, and avoiding global state

categories.name: Architecture & Design
categories.description: Value objects and pragmatic SOLID principles with explicit typed APIs

categories.name: PSR Standards
categories.description: PSR-4 autoloading, PSR-12 style, and naming/structure conventions

categories.name: Quality Tooling & Analysis
categories.description: Precise PHPDoc plus repository-configured PHPStan and formatting/style validation

keyFeatures: Detect the target PHP version before suggesting syntax or features
Canonical rule inventory is owned by SKILL.md and rules/
Strict native typing first; PHPDoc as a precision layer
Immutable/value-oriented design where it models real invariants
No magic-heavy APIs or silent diagnostic suppression
PHPStan/static-analysis and formatter/fixer validation through the repository toolchain
